notes: STD-20 / RFC-UI-LANG-1 P3: insert (replace, old value), ordered iteration over &m and &mut m (with break), get_mut in a match, String keys with struct values, deep clone then mutation of the clone, remove, contains_key, len. The hash is computed by rustc (Rust BTreeMap, the independent oracle), the IR interpreter and the JIT (ir_corpus_oracle).
